facts.fact: Challenges reports that BCT circulaire n°2026-10 imposes a mandatory annual cyber audit and stronger governance on payment institutions, keeps ceilings on accounts and transfers, and enters into force three months after its issue (published 2026-09-25 per the article's date context; the article gives no day).
facts.system: BCT circulaire n°2026-10 on payment institutions

facts.fact: Challenges reports that BCT circulaire n°2026-10 of September 2026 regulates payment institutions (établissements de paiement), which are not banks, setting audit and governance duties and ceilings on their accounts and transfers.
facts.system: BCT circulaire n°2026-10 on payment institutions
